head_coach.name: Pape Thiaw
head_coach.play_style_summary: Built around physical intensity, defensive compact compactness, and high-pressing tempo. Under Thiaw, the style has evolved into a possession-based game with dynamic movement, encouraging central midfielders to take creative risks in the final third while remaining highly organized in transitions.

key_players.name: Nicolas Jackson
key_players.performance_stats: Recorded a highly productive 82.28 minutes per goal contribution during his season-long loan at Bayern Munich. Highly valued for his physical presence, pressing, and penalty-box movement.

key_players.name: Lamine Camara
key_players.performance_stats: Dynamic double-pivot midfielder for AS Monaco. Praised for his elite passing range, work-rate, defensive disruptions, and tactical vision; won AFCON Best Young Player.
